masseria.title: Masseria Torre Abbondanza

masseria.storiaTitle: A story of land and tradition
masseria.storia1: Masseria Torre Abbondanza was born as a rural estate in the heart of the Trulli Valley, between Noci and Alberobello. Its white stone walls tell centuries of farming life, when masserie were the beating heart of Puglia's agricultural economy.
masseria.storia2: Since 2005, the Giunta family has transformed this place into a landmark for authentic hospitality: the historic hall with its 18th-century stone vaults hosts weddings and ceremonies, the kitchen serves traditional Pugliese flavours by reservation, and the Murgese horse breeding keeps alive one of Italy's oldest breeds.
masseria.storia3: Today the masseria lives with two souls in balance: the table and the gallop, the stone and the earth, memory and welcome. Every guest who crosses the threshold enters a continuing story.
masseria.vieniDesc: Book a visit to the masseria or discover our services for events, cuisine and horses.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Masseria Torre Abbondanza: reservations, events, cuisine, horses and how to reach us.
faq.noAnswerDesc: Write to us directly: we reply within 24 hours.
faq.a1: The kitchen opens by reservation for groups of at least 20 people with at least two days' notice. The menu is created together, tailored to Pugliese tradition, starting from €50 per person.
faq.q2: Can I host weddings or ceremonies at the masseria?
faq.a2: Yes. The 18th-century masseria hosts weddings, civil and symbolic ceremonies, baptisms, birthdays, private parties and corporate dinners both in the historic vaulted hall and in the outdoor courtyard among ancient olive trees.
faq.q3: Are vegetarian, vegan or gluten-free menus available?
faq.a3: Yes, on request we prepare dedicated vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free and children's menus to meet guests' needs.
faq.q4: Does the masseria breed and sell Murgese horses?
faq.a4: Yes. The Giunta family breeds registered Murgese horses (T.A. suffix), organises equestrian experiences, Historic Carriage Parades and offers international sales with shipping to Europe, Russia and China.
faq.q5: Can I arrive by historic carriage at a ceremony?
faq.a5: Yes, on request the ceremony entrance can open with a historic carriage drawn by the masseria's own Murgese horses.
faq.a6: It is located at Strada Vicinale per Massafra, Zona E n. 49, 70015 Noci (BA), in the heart of the Trulli Valley and Valle d'Itria, about 12 minutes from Putignano and Alberobello.
faq.a7: Yes, ample free parking inside the property, directly accessible from the vicinal road. Reserved spaces for guests with reduced mobility.
faq.q8: What is the maximum event capacity?
faq.a8: The masseria can host up to 250 guests between the historic hall and outdoor courtyard, with customisable setups depending on the event type.
faq.q9: How can I request a quote?
faq.a9: Contact us via WhatsApp or fill in the contact form on the Events page. We reply within 24 hours.
faq.q10: Can Murgese horses be exported abroad?
faq.a10: Yes. We handle all export documentation: EU passport, health certificates, CITES for non-EU countries, land and air transport. We serve Europe, Russia/CIS and China/Asia.
